facts.business: Jiya Eco Products Limited is an Indian listed company that underwent a resolution plan approved by NCLT Ahmedabad involving capital reduction and impairment of subsidiary investments.

auditor.name: M/s D R B S V AND ASSOCIATES, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on impairment of assets and derecognition of liabilities per resolution plan (Note 27.12, 27.13) and reduction in share capital and infusion of funds by Resolution Applicants (Note 27.07); opinion not modified.

key_risks: Impairment of assets and derecognition of liabilities per resolution plan
Reduction in share capital and infusion of funds by Resolution Applicants
Prior year financial statements audited by another auditor who expressed a disclaimer of opinion
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review there were no Contracts or arrangement with Related Parties which are required to be reported in Form No. AOC-2. However, details of outstanding balances as on 31.03.2026 are specifically mentioned in Note of 27.11 to the Audited Financial Statements as at 31.03.2026.
